name: Lids
notes: Primary shop link. Affiliate program via Impact. Put the approved tracking link template (with {url}) in AFFILIATE_DEEPLINK_LIDS, or plain tracking parameters in AFFILIATE_PARAMS_LIDS.

name: Lids Canada
notes: Lids Canada (lids.ca), used for Canada-only promo codes. Put its Impact tracking link template (with {url}) in AFFILIATE_DEEPLINK_LIDSCA, or plain tracking parameters in AFFILIATE_PARAMS_LIDSCA. Until one is set, links go to lids.ca with no tracking.

name: Fanatics
notes: Kept so older /out/search-fanatics-... links still resolve. Not the default shop.

name: Amazon
notes: Amazon Associates. Used only for jersey display, storage and care gear (src/lib/amazonPicks.ts), never for jerseys, which go to Lids. Set AFFILIATE_PARAMS_AMAZON to tag=<your store id>. Amazon prices are never shown, because Associates rules allow prices only from Amazon's own API.
